issue_context.title: Bluetooth SDP: When the SDP attribute length is greater than SDP_MTU, the attribute is discarded
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
When the length of an attribute in the SDP record is greater than SDP_MTU,
the select_attrs function discards the attribute.

**To Reproduce**
1. Configure an SDP service so that the length of one of the attributes is greater than SDP_MTU
2. Connect ZEPHYR via Bluetooth
3. Through the Bluetooth HCI log, it can be found that the attribute in the SDP returned by ZEPHYR
    returned an empty packet 

**Expected behavior**
SDP should divide the attribute into pieces and return the complete SDP record through multiple
BT_SDP_SVC_ATTR_REQ instructions 

**Impact**
HID report descriptor cannot be reported
comments: Hi @LuoZhongYao  do you mean that the one HID report descriptor attribute's data length is bigger than the SDP_MTU?
@MarkWangChinese Any attribute greater than SDP_MTU will do, but the HID report descriptor is usually larger, and it is easier to exceed SDP_MTU

Hi @LuoZhongYao  please have a try with https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/42166, SDP_ONE_ATTRIBUTE_MAX_LEN is the max attribute length, you may need change it if you hid descriptor length is bigger.
